subject: Request: Delivery scope/SLA waiver + onboarding credit for OptiHealth
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@optihealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal + bundled onboarding & premium support options for OptiHealth

Hi Daniel —

Thanks for the call yesterday. Attached is an updated SOW (v3) showing the bundled onboarding package we discussed: two weeks of on-site (or remote) implementation, dedicated onboarding engineer, and Premium Support for 12 months.

Key commercials: list price for the bundle is $125k; I'm showing a standard onboarding credit of $10k for first-time customers. Given the scope (custom HL7 connector + EHR validation), I flagged this to Deal Desk for discretionary onboarding credit and an SLA addendum.

Questions for you: can you confirm the target go-live window (you mentioned end of Q2) and whether the ED team will provide test data for connector validation?

Attachments: SOW_v3_OptiHealth.pdf, pricing_breakdown_OptiHealth.xlsx, support_matrix.png

Thanks —
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---
Redwood Inference | alex_martinez@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0193
From: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@optihealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: OptiHealth Procurement <procurement@optihealth.com>, Hammond Legal <contracts@hammondlegal.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal + bundled onboarding & premium support options for OptiHealth

Alex —

Appreciate the SOW. A few items from our side before legal/finance will sign off: 

- We need a one-time onboarding credit to cover the EHR connector dev effort. Requested credit: $40k (we believe the custom HL7 work is material).
- SLA: can you add a clause for 99.5% availability for inference endpoints supporting production workflows, and a 4-hour P1 response for Premium Support?
- Deliverables: HL7 connector must include unit tests and a validation run with our test data; we need this spelled out in the SOW.

If you can get Deal Desk / Executive approval on the onboarding credit and a short SLA amendment, we can route to our procurement and legal next week.

Thanks —
Daniel Kim
Director of Digital Health, OptiHealth
Daniel.Kim@optihealth.com
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Proposal + bundled onboarding & premium support options for OptiHealth — request for credit + SLA amendment

Rishi / Laura —

Forwarding OptiHealth's reply. They are asking for a $40k one-time onboarding credit (custom HL7 connector) and explicit SLA items (99.5% availability for prod endpoints, 4-hour P1 response). The ARR for this deal if signed is $480k annually (hosted inference + Premium Support).

My read: the custom connector is billable but the account is strategic in our Northeast health vertical and this will be a strong reference. I'm recommending we approve up to $30k credit and agree to an SLA amendment limited to the endpoints covered by the bundle. However, Daniel's ask is $40k and 4-hour P1 — that latter is tighter than our standard Premium Support.

Can you advise: 1) Deal Desk appetite for $40k credit or counter at $25–30k? 2) Legal acceptable language for a scoped SLA addendum with 4-hr P1 only for the premium bundle?

- Alex
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: Proposal + bundled onboarding & premium support options for OptiHealth — request for credit + SLA amendment

Marissa —

Quick analysis (summary):
- Contract value/ARR: ~$480k ARR, onboarding rev of $125k (one-time)
- Requested onboarding credit: $40k (=32% of onboarding rev) — exceeds our standard discretionary threshold for AE sign-off (15%).
- Recommended compromise: approve up to $30k onboarding credit on condition that OptiHealth executes the SLA addendum and accepts time-boxed acceptance tests (2 validation runs). Also require statement of work update that lists HL7 deliverables and test data handoff schedule.
- SLA: 99.5% availability is acceptable if limited to the inference endpoints included in the Premium bundle and with explicit maintenance windows; P1 4-hour response is aggressive but acceptable for 12 months on Premium at this pricing. We should include an exception clause that escalates to Support Engineering for systemic issues.

Decision ask (for exec sign-off): Approve $30k onboarding credit + scoped SLA addendum + SOW update. If approved, Deal Desk will provide an approval memo and send updated SOW/DocuSign link.

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Deal Desk Manager
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: APPROVED: OptiHealth onboarding credit & SLA addendum (conditions)

Team —

Approved as requested by Rishi with the following conditions (please finalize language and route to OptiHealth):
1) One-time onboarding credit: $30,000 (to be applied against the onboarding invoice).
2) SOW must include: HL7 connector deliverables, unit tests, two validation runs with OptiHealth test data, and a mutually agreed acceptance checklist.
3) SLA addendum: 99.5% availability limited to the production inference endpoints in the Premium bundle; 4-hour P1 response for 12 months. Include defined maintenance windows and an escalation path to Support Engineering.
4) Credit approval is contingent on signed SOW + executed SLA addendum and OptiHealth agreeing to a case-volume cap clause (if production usage exceeds X tokens/month we re-evaluate pricing).

Alex — please update the SOW and pricing file, attach a short approval memo from Deal Desk, and send the DocuSign link to OptiHealth procurement. Laura — please help with the SLA wording and the case-volume cap language; flag any legal redlines from Hammond Legal. Rishi — once SOW is updated, please create the approval memo for signature.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: approval_memo_template.docx
DocuSign: https://docusign.net/OptiHealth-SOW-v3
